score_arithmetic: exact rational fractions; export decimal and exact fraction
round_robin: existing branch_balanced_unique with original generated perspective order; replay must exactly match saved Top20
aggregation: average three dynamic repeats within each original query, then macro over defined original queries
zero_positive_queries: Recall and F1 undefined, never imputed zero
mechanism_diagnostics: For original-positive loss events record every local rank, exact RR selection trace, min-rank cutoffs5/10/20, and fixed-fusion counterfactual rescue. Cutoffs are diagnostics only, never candidate filters or oracle ranking systems.
architectural_status: User-authorized diagnostic RRF comparison, not the professor-proposed architecture or a learned Query-Case reranker
interpretation: Dev same-model AI-Silver only. Union of all112 candidates is not itself retrieval improvement. Historical original baselines are evaluated once, not three independent repeats.
